title: Hedging an Opinion
goal: Hedge an opinion with puede ser que, es posible que and quizás, and use ¿acaso...? as a rhetorical question.

items: I can hedge an opinion with puede ser que and es posible que.
I can use ¿acaso...? for a question that is not a real question.
I can use the new words for discussing an idea.
